name: Recital F
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Belgium - EGF/2024/003 BE/Van Hool
part_text: F. whereas the European automotive and supplier industry is facing unprecedented pressure from both external and internal challenges, such as distortion of competition, high-energy costs and the European Green Deal which which provides for the end of internal combustion vehicles by 2035, the implementation of which it will be necessary to suspend, otherwise the European automotive and supplier industry will be condemned to failure and the cost of mobility for Europeans will increase;
